messages:
Janice (Support): FYI - AcmeMaps reported a burst of 504/gateway timeouts hitting /v1/generate around 2024-12-02T14:21Z. They said it coincided with a marketing email -> ~3x QPS spike. Ticket INC-23981. Sample request-id: req_8a3f2c. No JSON 5xx body, just upstream timeout.
Tom (SRE): Can you paste the curl + headers so we can correlate logs (request-id and tenant id)? Also is model pinned?
Janice (Support): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" -H "x-request-id: req_8a3f2c" -d '{"model":"rwd-open-13b","input":"route planning..."}'
Janice (Support): Customer confirmed model pinned to rwd-open-13b, sync request, streaming disabled.
OpsBot: autoscaler: scale_up group=hosted-13b-pool count:+4 reason="queue_backlog" at 2024-12-02T14:23:07Z
Tom (SRE): Pulling metrics now. Prom queries I ran: 
  # backlog length over last 10m
  max(request_queue_backlog_count{model="rwd-open-13b"}) by (instance)

  # tail latency p95/p99
  histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
Alex (Eng Runtime): Looking at infra metrics - backlog jumped to ~1300 across the pool. Single node queue_limit=256, global soft-limit 1024. We crossed the soft limit; continuous batcher backlog ballooned, per-request enqueue wait >60s -> gateway 504s. Also saw many batch assembly stalls from very long sequence lengths.
Tom (SRE): Got the kc logs for req_8a3f2c: "WARN batcher: enqueue timeout after 60000ms, queue_depth=1024, batch_size_target=512" then "ERROR gateway: upstream timeout". Matches the customer report.
Alex (Eng Runtime): Root cause hypothesis: sudden QPS spike + a disproportionate number of long-context requests (avg seq_len ~12k tokens) extended batch assembly times. Continuous batching waits to hit batch targets which spikes tail latency; soft rejects were delayed so head-of-line blocking occurred.
Ryan (Eng Runtime): Short-term mitigations we can try:
- reduce continuous_batching.max_wait_ms to 20ms for rwd-open-13b
- set max_batch_size to 128
- enable fallback to quantized variant rwd-open-13b-q4 for best-effort during bursts
- proactively evict super-long-context requests with 413 or 429 when backlog > threshold
Tom (SRE): I'll disable continuous batching for rwd-open-13b and scale the pool +6 instances now. Applying changes.
OpsBot: deployment: update policy rwd-open-13b "continuous_batching=off" by tom at 2024-12-02T14:29:12Z
OpsBot: compute_pool: add_instances group=hosted-13b-pool count=6 at 2024-12-02T14:30:03Z
Janice (Support): AcmeMaps reports errors dropped from ~30% -> ~2% after changes. They still see a handful of long requests failing.
Maria (Customer Success): I'll offer a remediation call and recommend sharding requests, switching to streaming where possible, and using the q4 fallback for bursty loads. Also suggest a rate-limit advisory for the campaign.
BillingBot: note: transient high-usage spike detected for tenant acmemaps - flagged for billing review, no charge action taken yet.
Tom (SRE): Follow-ups: create postmortem with graphs (queue_backlog, batcher_wait_ms, p99 pre/post), add per-model hard queue_limit that rejects earlier (429), add alert: queue_backlog>800 for >2m -> auto-disable continuous batching, and run a canary synthetic test with long-context load.
Alex (Eng Runtime): Quick config snippet we applied: 
```
model_config:
  name: rwd-open-13b
  continuous_batching:
    enabled: false
  runtime:
    max_batch_size: 128
    enqueue_timeout_ms: 50
```
Tom (SRE): Filed INC-23981-POST. Owners: Alex (runtime) for config + canary, Tom (SRE) for scaling and alerting, Maria for CSM comms, Janice for support follow-up.
Janice (Support): Customer very appreciative of fast response; will keep open 24h and close if no regression. :white_check_mark: 
Ryan (Eng Runtime): Long-term item: investigate prefix-cache-aware batching (avoid waiting on large seq_len preds), smarter circuit-breakers to prevent p99-driven cascades. Adding to eng-runtime backlog.
OpsBot: incident: resolved -> monitoring for 2h
